title: Interview of the C-130 pilot in Bozeman for True Legends

tellings.quote: we flew him out to Boseman, Montana, and we interviewed him, Steve and I.

plain: A filmmaker named Tim Alberino says that he and his collaborator Steve Quayle flew the pilot of a C-130, a military cargo plane, to Bozeman, Montana, and interviewed him for their project True Legends. Alberino tells it as someone who was there, in an episode about a 12-foot giant he says was captured in Afghanistan, and he presents the pilot as a witness to that story.
